cohort: The study included 116 women admitted for induction of labor with full term pregnancy.
finding: Vaginal Misoprostol was more effective than Prostaglandin E2 for elective induction of labor, resulting in shorter induction to labor and delivery intervals.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in the Misoprostol group (24.1%) compared to the Prostaglandin E2 group (12.1%).
